(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for facilitating a medical order/prescription of a prescription product for a patient covered by a provider, comprising: at least one memory device to store a plurality of predefined forms for the prescription product, the plurality of predefined forms corresponding to a plurality of providers, the prescription product including a biologic product; a receiver to receive prescription product information for the prescription product and patient intake information for the patient, including provider information for the patient, and to receive a benefits summary related to the patient in response to a benefits verification request; a transmitter to transmit the benefits verification request; and at least one processor configured to: generate the benefits verification request for the patient based on the patient intake information; select one of the predefined forms based on at least the patient provider information; populate at least one field of the selected predefined form based on the patient intake information; and release the populated predefined form to facilitate a medical order/prescription of the prescription product to the patient using the predefined form.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The system of claim 1, wherein facilitating the medical order/prescription includes facilitating execution of a medical order/prescription of the prescription product or facilitating approval of a payment for the prescription product.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The system of claim 1, wherein the transmitter is further configured to transmit a request for additional patient information related to the prescription product.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The system of claim 1, wherein the processor is configured to release the populated predefined form to the provider specified for the patient.

(Currently Amended) Claim 30: The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 28, wherein the biologic product comprises an anti-inflammatory agent that modulates the immune response.
